steps.title: Import one year of AP data
steps.say: A year of invoices arrives from three source systems (ERP, accounts payable, purchasing cards), each with its own vendor list. Nothing has been cleaned yet.

steps.title: Merge four spellings into one vendor
steps.say: The same supplier was typed differently in each system. Entity resolution compares names, tax ids, bank accounts and addresses and decides which records are one company.

steps.title: Classify uncategorized spend
steps.say: A quarter of invoice lines came with no category. A classifier reads each line's description and files it in the spend taxonomy, with a confidence.

steps.title: A duplicate invoice, and an hourly rate above contract
steps.say: Duplicates hide behind a changed invoice number and a different spelling of the vendor. Separately, a consulting firm's contract is read for its rate card, with the clause each rate came from.

steps.title: Annualized leakage
steps.say: Every contract is read and every invoice line checked against it: hours billed above the rate card, volume rebates earned but never credited, and payments made twice.

steps.title: Six overlapping software vendors
steps.say: Six suppliers sell much the same collaboration software to different teams. Moving the smaller four onto the two largest is a consolidation opportunity, ranked alongside the money simply owed back.

steps.title: Negotiation dossier and the savings pipeline
steps.say: Everything known about the consulting firm on one page for the renewal conversation, and the pipeline total for the CFO.
